data_scope: synthetic HDF5 signals and engineering seeds only; no RIKEN signal reads or real claim
initial_validation: one collection/import/static check, then one full affected-suite invocation per implementation revision
post_R1_read_only_verifier_change_valida: one targeted non-native complete-suffix synthetic case for attribution of future shared-ledger appends; no repeated native batch
R3_closure_revision_validation: one invocation of exactly four non-native synthetic cases: complete suffix, unknown child, child exit, and tail-overrun plus complete violation-line loss; full logs retained, stop at first failure; no native batch repetition
R4_exact_closing_bytes_validation: one metadata-only boundary test for including prospective closed-receipt bytes before creation; no supervised repeat
R5_failure_recording_validation: one non-native tail-overrun case after adding durable final-audit failure recording; remove the entire violation suffix and require failure without a closure receipt; no native batch repetition
native_rule: fixed consecutive three-run batch; stop at first failure, preserve all earlier successes and failure; no fourth run to obtain a pass
failure_rule: preserve complete fixture, control/evidence/watchdog/terminal files and process-group diagnostics; any code correction is separately recorded before a new revision's validation
fault_cases_per_revision: one each: unauthorized/mismatched identity, corrupted prior record, duplicate/concurrent claim, claim-then-controller-exit, unknown child, child exit, budget exhaustion, output/closure corruption
